items.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: a predictive map of every possible DNA letter change in the human genome
items.excerpt: DeepMind released AlphaGenome Atlas, molecular predictions for roughly 9 billion possible single-letter human DNA variants, turning a genome model into a browsable reference map for researchers.

items.title: AI uncovers hidden Ozempic side effects across 400,000 Reddit posts
items.excerpt: AI analysis of 400,000 Reddit posts found that users of GLP-1 drugs such as Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro and Zepbound reported unexpected symptoms that clinical trials had missed.

items.title: AI can now control fusion plasma faster than humans can react
items.excerpt: Princeton researchers tested PACMAN, an AI system that monitors and controls fusion plasma in milliseconds, reacting far faster than a human operator can.

items.title: Earth From Orbit Is Unpredictable and Messy. Could 'Liquid' AI Clear the View?
items.excerpt: Monitoring Earth from orbit is messy: clouds block views, sun angles create shadows and orbits shift. Researchers propose liquid neural networks to keep Earth-observation models adapting in real time.

items.title: How AI can help with early schizophrenia diagnosis
items.excerpt: The speech of people with schizophrenia sounds subtly different from that of healthy counterparts. Researchers are testing whether AI can hear those differences earlier and better than human psychiatrists.

items.title: If AI can do math, what's the point of mathematicians?
items.excerpt: What happens when machines surpass the most brilliant human minds? Mathematicians are finding out as AI systems start clearing research-level problems.

items.title: AI may have just solved a million-dollar math problem. The field will never be the same
items.excerpt: A mathematician compared the feat to the history-making 1997 chess match in which IBM's Deep Blue beat Garry Kasparov.

items.title: See the highest-resolution footage of a black hole jet ever taken, thanks to AI and 27 years of observations
items.excerpt: Researchers combined more than 100 images of a single black hole into an AI-reconstructed video charting the activity of a mighty blazar jet.

items.title: Using AI to plan for climate variability in renewable energy systems
items.excerpt: A new AI approach models how batteries and hydrogen storage can improve renewable energy reliability under a changing climate.

items.title: AI helps find hidden human proteins and reveals what they do
items.excerpt: Researchers used AI to scan over 214 million predicted proteins by 3D structure rather than sequence, surfacing unrecognized GPCR-family members including TM184C and its role in cell-to-cell bridges.

items.title: Smart, self-healing packaging uses AI to detect food spoilage in real time
items.excerpt: Researchers describe packaging that can 'see' what is happening inside a container and use AI to translate those signals into real-time spoilage information for producers and consumers.

items.title: Can AI tame torrential rain by 2050? The next frontier of weather control and forecasting
items.excerpt: Japanese researchers are pairing AI forecasting with an unconventional plan to artificially induce heavy rainfall over the ocean to blunt extreme downpours on land.

items.title: NASA, IBM launch new AI model for studying the moon
items.excerpt: NASA and IBM released a Lunar Foundation Model trained on 17 years of orbital data, letting scientists map ice, craters and volcanic terrain across the moon.

items.title: Healthcare AI's next test is integration
items.excerpt: Advanced AI excels at processing clinical data, but healthcare's real test is overcoming deeply fragmented administrative workflows.

items.title: Researchers and AI agents cut estimated quantum cost of attacking Bitcoin encryption by 86%
items.excerpt: An open project pairing 100+ human scientists with AI coding agents cut the estimated quantum resources for elliptic-curve point addition by 86.1%, a rare demonstration of agents doing real research optimization.

items.title: Interaction Profiles as a Universal Language for Generative Molecular Design with ShEPhERD-2
items.excerpt: A generative model conditions molecular design on 3D intermolecular interaction profiles rather than sequence or graph descriptors, aiming at more controllable small-molecule drug design.

items.title: DNT: Diploid Genomic Foundation Model
items.excerpt: A genomic foundation model that represents both haplotypes of a diploid genome, a step past the haploid-reference assumption baked into most DNA language models.

items.title: Can AI Have Conscious Experiences?
items.excerpt: A neuroscientist argues that asking whether AI can be programmed to be conscious misunderstands both the brain and consciousness itself.

items.title: AI and the Threat of Cognitive Inhibition
items.excerpt: What if AI does more than compete with human thought and begins to change our propensity to engage in thinking at all?
